system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: armor-policy
  type: compute.v1.securityPolicy
  properties:
    name: prod-cloud-armor-policy
    description: "Production Cloud Armor policy with geo-blocking and per-IP rate limiting"
    rules:
    - priority: 1000
      action: deny(403)
      description: "Block traffic from high-risk countries"
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "origin.region_code.matches('^(CN|RU|IR|KP|CU)$')"
    - priority: 2000
      action: throttle
      description: "Rate limit 100 requests per minute per IP"
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges: ["*"]
      rateLimitOptions:
        rateLimitThreshold:
          count: 100
          intervalSec: 60
        conformAction: allow
        exceedAction: deny(429)
        enforceOnKey: IP
    - priority: 2147483647
      action: allow
      description: "Default allow rule"
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges: ["*"]
